title: The Palace Voice — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of The Palace Voice's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. pieces.title: The dial that drifted
pieces.caption: Em-dashes and bold per thousand words, month by month. Em-dashes climb from 14 to 22 by midsummer, then fall to 15 after the August gate. *What is real and what is a choice:* Counted across every .md at each month's last commit. In this count bold did not rise; the page's 41 and 53 percent were measured some other way. *Leaking in:* Drift and Consolidation: drift, then the day it got tracked.

verdicts.why: The series is reproduced, but the chart answers a different question from the page and then leans on it: it pools every tracked .md, and the fall "to 15 once the gate was in" is mostly dilution. All-.md words went from 0.99M in August to 2.34M in November while canon-entry prose stayed near 450K;
